name: Uluca Rufen
source:
"Hey, if you're going to wake me up, wake me up sooner!!"

An unhappy boy who was forced to move early on in the semester due to a leak in his room. Even at this year's Falling Night Festival, he was unlucky enough to be given the troublesome role of the Morning Messenger. Before he knew it, he was caught up in a vortex.

He has a stubborn and distrustful side that makes him only believe things he has seen and experienced. 

He has a typical temperament, which is rare in the academy, and his current concern is the content of the school cafeteria's avant-garde menu.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120305145026/http://senz.jp/chara.html]official website[/url]]
